en.text: We must develop and maintain the capacity to forgive. He who is devoid of the power to forgive is devoid of the power to love. There is some good in the worst of us and some evil in the best of us. When we discover this, we are less prone to hate our enemies.

original: この間、面と向かってホモって言われる夢見た。

en.text: Recently, I dreamt that "Homo!" was said to my face.

original: 俺に面と向かってよくもそんなこと言えるな。

en.text: How can you say that to my face?

original: 全ての面において、非の打ち所がない。

en.text: You're absolutely perfect, in every way.

2012910.reading: ひのうちどころがない

original: ちょっと面貸しな！

en.text: Meet me face to face for a moment!
Come here for a moment!
